name: voxelcraft
description: Voxel sandbox 3D game inspired by Minecraft — castle, village, NPCs, redstone, PWA + Android APK.

scripts.cap:android: cap add android || true && cap sync android
scripts.cap:ios: cap add ios || true && cap sync ios
scripts.android:build: npm run build && cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
